title: Hennig takes Arn’s place, then betrays the Horsemen
summary: Arn Anderson offers his Horsemen position to Curt Hennig. The apparent renewal becomes a trap that leaves Flair and his allies at the nWo’s mercy.

chapters.title: Anderson offers Hennig his spot
chapters.result: Anderson announces his retirement and invites Hennig to replace him.
chapters.context: An emotional transfer of responsibility places the Horsemen’s trust in the newcomer.

chapters.title: Hennig turns inside WarGames
chapters.result: Hennig betrays the Horsemen, helping the nWo win.
chapters.context: The attack on Flair, including the cage door, turns Anderson’s gesture of trust into a damaging deception.
